title: AI-Powered Platform
banner_subtitle: AutoGenNet — an AutoML platform for developing computer vision models
problem_1_text: There are many deep learning architectures, the list of which is poorly systematized. Platforms for aggregating information are only gaining popularity.
problem_2_text: There is no single method for generating and training models — different algorithms are suitable for specific tasks, requiring individual refinement.
problem_3_text: Existing solutions are often implemented as prototypes that require deep modification for the task and understanding of the architecture by an ML specialist.
solution_desc: AutoGenNet solves the above problems through a comprehensive AutoML approach that covers all stages of creating computer vision models:
solution_1_text: Automatic processing, cleaning and expansion of datasets to improve model quality
solution_2_text: Automatic architecture selection and fine-tuning of hyperparameters without manual intervention
solution_3_text: Using knowledge from previous projects to accelerate the training of new models
solution_4_text: Intuitive UI for synthesizing and managing models without deep technical knowledge
solution_5_text: Ready-made APIs and scripts for quick integration of models into existing systems
accordion_1_text: They automate program creation but require the participation of machine learning experts for use. Examples: AutoKeras, auto-sklearn.
accordion_2_text: They automate program creation but are proprietary solutions and require the participation of machine learning experts for use. Example: Google Cloud AutoML.
accordion_3_text: They automate the entire model design cycle but have limitations when integrating created models into third-party software, are proprietary solutions and require experts in these packages for use. Example: Matlab.
accordion_4_text: They automate the design of individual deep learning architectures or solve specific AutoML tasks but do not use a comprehensive approach to solving problems. Examples: GosNIIAS, ITMO.
module_1_text: Automatic annotation accelerates the preparation of large and high-quality datasets for training neural networks. It reduces manual annotation costs, improves accuracy due to tag consistency, and allows scaling projects quickly and launching new models.
module_2_text: Automatic augmentation creates new versions of images — rotations, scaling, lighting changes. This increases the volume and diversity of the dataset without additional data collection costs. The module reduces overfitting and helps models perform better on real, unpredictable data.
module_3_title: Automatic Object Detection Model Generation Module
module_3_text: The module automatically manages the entire detector training cycle: architecture selection, hyperparameter tuning and quality assessment. This drastically reduces development time and eliminates manual setup errors. The result is accurate and ready-to-deploy models for transportation, security, logistics and other industries.
module_4_title: Automatic Image Segmentation Model Generation Module
module_4_text: Allows quick training of high-precision models for pixel-level object segmentation. Automation of complex stages — architecture search and parameter tuning — accelerates iterations and reduces requirements for expert knowledge. Models are suitable for medicine, autonomous systems and agriculture.
module_5_title: Automatic Video Monitoring Model Generation Module
module_5_text: Automates the training of video object segmentation and tracking models. This significantly reduces labor costs and accelerates the development of solutions for autonomous driving, medical video analysis and intelligent surveillance, including drone use.
module_6_text: AutoGenNet creates not only models but also software wrappers for their launch: Python scripts, as well as SOAP and REST APIs. This allows integrating models into external systems and IoT devices without ML specialists — quickly and with minimal costs.
module_7_text: Allows collecting data on-site (photos, videos), sending it to the cloud for processing and receiving instant results. Accelerates modeling iterations — ideal for inspectors, agronomists and medical personnel.
roadmap_1_text: Increasing the set of supported deep learning architectures to improve model generation quality.
roadmap_2_text: Development of an optimized automatic model generation algorithm — acceleration and accuracy improvement.
